items.title: Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)
items.summary: After the August 26 floods, search teams have recovered 734 bodies and rescued more than 8,000 people, but nearly 2,500 remain unaccounted for. Over 400 of the missing are foreign nationals.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River on August 26, and teams have recovered 626 bodies while about 2400 people remain unaccounted for. Over 4450 people have been rescued so far, including more than 187 foreign nationals, with work continuing in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading and Chitwan.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River on August 26, killing many people and damaging homes, roads, bridges, and other buildings. Rescue teams have recovered 538 bodies so far, with hundreds of locals and tourists still missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue teams and helicopters are at the mudslide site in Gyirong Port after the slide hit Wednesday morning. As of Thursday at 8 a.m., three people had been killed, 558 were missing, and two villagers had been pulled out.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August. Rescue teams have recovered 359 bodies so far, while 596 people from 33 countries remain missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: Nepal's foreign ministry has opened an emergency room to help with foreign nationals missing or affected by the Rasuwa floods. Families can call +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 from 7am to 10pm.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood

items.title: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
items.summary: India's foreign ministry has opened a 24-hour control room in Delhi for the Nepal floods. Families can reach the team by phone, WhatsApp, or email, and the Indian embassies in Kathmandu and Beijing have lines open as well.
items.citation: MEA press release — Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River this morning, killing people and damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. So far 72 bodies have been recovered and 403 people are reported missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026

items.title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
items.summary: The Indian embassy in Kathmandu is working with local authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals caught in the floods around Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi. Families can call the Delhi control room on +91-11-23088718 or +91-11-23088719, WhatsApp +91-9968291988, or message the embassy at +977-9851316807.
items.citation: Embassy of India, Kathmandu
